title: My first stablecoin
tagline: This is my first project in a hackathon, I am creating a stable coin
description:
This is my first project in a hackathon, I am creating a stable coin

I created a stablecoin on Ethereum Sepolia
My smart contract was from a workshop made by Solange Gueiros in BlockchainRio.

I am using Chainlink services:
- Data Feed - get the ETH/USD price
- Automation - to manage the liquidation process when it is undercollateralized
how_its_made:
This is my first project in a hackathon, I am creating a stable coin

I created a stablecoin on Ethereum Sepolia
My smart contract was from a workshop made by Solange Gueiros in BlockchainRio.

The token is an ERC20 token, using OpenZeppelin libraries.

I am using Chainlink services:
- Data Feed - get the ETH/USD price
- Automation - to manage the liquidation process when it is undercollateralized
